name: Anchorage Sheet Metal
old_description: Anchorage Sheet Metal is a locally owned and operated custom fabrication shop located in south Anchorage. With services ranging from ventilation systems to staircase handrails to custom works of art, make Anchorage Sheet Metal your preferred provider of custom metal fabrication and all HVAC needs. Not only are our servicemen licensed bonded and insured, we are also HVAC certified.
about:
Anchorage Sheet Metal, a locally owned and operated custom fabrication shop, has served south Anchorage, Alaska, for over 26 years from its facility on Toloff Street. The company provides custom metal fabrication and comprehensive HVAC services to clients throughout the region.

The shop specializes in stainless steel fabrication, offering computerized plasma cutting, on-site welding and polishing, and equipment repair and modification. Its capabilities extend to ventilation systems, staircase handrails, and custom artistic metalwork, all backed by a mechanical contractor license and a team of licensed, bonded, and insured technicians.

The company serves commercial, residential, and industrial clients across Alaska, delivering HVAC installations, custom ductwork, and fabricated stainless steel components for equipment and structural applications. Projects range from commercial kitchen ventilation to architectural handrails and one-of-a-kind metal art installations.

Anchorage Sheet Metal emphasizes its licensed, bonded, and insured workforce, HVAC certification, and competitive pricing as key differentiators in the regional market, positioning itself as a single-source provider for both fabrication and mechanical contracting needs.
